days.file: Jan Victors - Hanna, moeder van Samuel, biddend in de tempel - DM-861-327 - Dordrechts Museum.jpg
days.title: Hannah Prays in the Temple
days.alt: Hannah, in a red hat and fur-trimmed robe, kneels with her hands clasped and looks out with red-rimmed eyes, the priest Eli seated in the shadows behind her.
days.look: Look again at Hannah’s clasped hands. What would you pour out to God, just as it is?
days.license: Artist died 1676; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Domenico Ghirlandaio - Angel Appearing to Zacharias (detail) - WGA8851.jpg
days.title: The Angel Appears to Zechariah
days.place: Tornabuoni Chapel, Santa Maria Novella, Florence
days.alt: An angel in a gold robe steps toward the altar, and Zechariah stands among a group of men in red robes.
days.look: Look again at Zechariah standing quietly before the altar. Can you rest in being faithful, even while the answer is hidden?
days.license: Artist died 1494; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Giotto di Bondone - No. 6 Scenes from the Life of Joachim - 6. Meeting at the Golden Gate - WGA09176.jpg
days.title: The Meeting at the Golden Gate
days.alt: Joachim and Anne embrace at the city gate, her hand on his shoulder, while women look on.
days.look: Look again at Joachim and Anne holding each other. What does your spouse most need you to hear today?
days.license: Artist died 1337; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Giotto - The Expulsion of Joachim from the Temple - Scrovegni Chapel.jpeg
days.title: The Expulsion of Joachim from the Temple
days.alt: A priest at the altar turns Joachim away, and Joachim, in a rose robe with a golden halo, stands with his head bowed.
days.look: Look again at Joachim, left outside with his gift. Who could you weep with, or rejoice with, today?
days.license: Artist died 1337; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: Joachim’s Dream
days.alt: Two shepherds stand on a rocky hillside beside their sheep while Joachim sleeps wrapped in a rose cloak in front of a small hut.
days.look: Look again at the shepherds keeping watch beside Joachim. What are you waiting for in the dark?
days.license: Artist died 1337; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Tissot Solomon Dedicates the Temple at Jerusalem.jpg
days.title: Solomon Dedicates the Temple at Jerusalem
days.alt: Solomon stands on the temple steps in a robe and breastplate with his arms raised in prayer, while a crowd kneels before him.
days.look: Look again at Solomon’s raised arms. What wisdom are you asking for today?
days.license: Artist died 1902; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Fra Angelico - Noli Me Tangere (Cell 1) - WGA00535.jpg
days.title: Noli Me Tangere
days.alt: Mary Magdalene kneels in a red robe and reaches toward Jesus, who stands in a white robe in a garden with one hand held out to her.
days.look: Look again at the hands held out between Mary and Jesus. Can you trust that the Lord is this near to you in your grief?
days.license: Artist died 1455; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.file: Christ the Vine Late Cretan School.png
days.title: The True Vine
days.alt: Christ sits at the heart of a spreading vine, with an apostle holding each branch around Him.
days.look: Look again at the branches growing from Christ. How does your love bear fruit already?
days.license: Artist died 1687; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)

days.title: The Annunciation (Cestello)
days.alt: The angel Gabriel kneels at the left with one hand raised, and Mary at the right bows her head with her hand open in reply.
days.look: Look again at Mary’s open hand. What would it be like to place everything in God’s hands today?
days.license: Artist died 1510; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
